content: Nix reference manual (nix.dev + releases.nixos.org, official, versions 2.19–2.35): import-from-derivation triggers when a builtin that reads the filesystem receives an expr that is a store path (import, readFile, readDir, pathExists, path, hashFile etc). Evaluation pauses, realises the store object sequentially, resumes — much slower than normal realisation parallelism, and can be disabled with allow-import-from-derivation = false. Rule: keep eval-time reads limited to source files in the repo (relative paths, imported directly), never to built derivations. For nixify: no patterns like  at eval, no builtins.getFlake on machine-local flakes, no import of generated files. Extra eval-speed levers: single nixpkgs instance (useGlobalPkgs=true avoids HM evaluating its own pkgs set), lazy flake outputs (avoid forcing all hosts when building one via nix flake check current-system semantics and checks per system), nix flake check --all-systems for cross-eval.
